name: blender game dev learning path advice
goal: Follow a game-dev-oriented Blender learning order: basics → low-poly assets → early engine export → optional sculpt/bake.

source.title: Learning BLENDER as a GAME DEV

inputs.name: target_engine
inputs.description: Game engine you will export to

outputs.name: learning_plan
outputs.description: Ordered practice plan emphasizing low-poly and early export

constraints: If following Blender Guru donut, stopping around part 5 is suggested for game-dev focus in this video
Export to engine early to catch pipeline issues

steps.action: Optionally do a short beginner control/UI tutorial (donut parts early only if used).
Prioritize low-poly game-asset fundamentals where polygon count matters over dense non-game scenes.
Export a simple mesh to your game engine as early as possible; fix export issues before detailing.
Practice easy low-poly models on your own; then study rigging; later sculpting and baking high-to-low when needed.
Finish a small personal/game-jam asset project end-to-end for retention.

verification: Written plan lists low-poly → export → project milestones
